question: At the age of 102, who became the oldest man to summit Mount Fuji, Japan’s tallest peak, on August 5, 2025, setting a new Guinness World Record?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kokichi Akuzawa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Kokichi Akuzawa, aged 102, became the oldest man to summit Mount Fuji, setting a new Guinness World Record on August 5, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kokichi Akuzawa, a seasoned mountaineer, overcame multiple health setbacks to achieve this remarkable feat.**
 
• **The summit of Mount Fuji is at 3,776 meters, and Akuzawa’s climb, completed with his family, became an inspiration to many.**
 
• **Akuzawa trained for three months leading up to the climb, engaging in daily walks and climbing mountains weekly.**
 
• **This climb marked his second attempt at the record, having previously set the title at age 96 before surpassing it at 102.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Mount Fuji__

 __
 
• Mount Fuji is Japan's highest peak, standing at 3,776 meters, and is considered an iconic symbol of the country.
 
 
 
• Guinness World Records__
 
 
• Guinness World Records is an international organization that tracks and certifies world records across various categories.
